record.field: Federal income tax rates by annual taxable income, as [[threshold, rate], ...]. The bracket constant K of the payroll formulas is derived from the table and rounded to the dollar. Income Tax Act s. 117(2), indexed under s. 117.1. The lowest rate is 15% until June 2025 and 14% from July 1, 2025 (T4127 option 1, 121st edition), 14% from 2026. Sources: T4127 table 8.1, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/I-3.3/

Lowest federal rate applied to the personal credits (K1, K2, K4 of the payroll formulas). Income Tax Act s. 117(2) and 118. For 2025 the payroll formulas apply 15% to June 30 (T4127 120th edition) and 14% from July 1 (121st edition); the Act as amended by S.C. 2026, c. 2 sets 14.5% for the 2025 tax year, which the employee's return reconciles. Sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/payroll-deductions-t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan-120th-edition-effective-january-1-2025/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html

Maximum federal basic personal amount (BPAF), claimed up to the phase-out start. Income Tax Act s. 118(1)(c), indexed under s. 117.1. Sources: T4127 chapter 4 and table 8.9, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html

Federal basic personal amount from the phase-out end (BPAF). Income Tax Act s. 118(1)(c). Source: T4127 chapter 4, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html
Federal basic personal amount - phase-out start

Annual net income above which the federal basic personal amount decreases (start of the fourth federal bracket). Income Tax Act s. 118(1)(c). Source: T4127 chapter 4, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html
Federal basic personal amount - phase-out end

Annual net income from which the federal basic personal amount is the minimum (start of the fifth federal bracket). Income Tax Act s. 118(1)(c). Source: T4127 chapter 4, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html

Canada employment amount (CEA, credit K4). Income Tax Act s. 118(10). Source: T4127 table 8.2, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html

Refundable Quebec abatement deducted from the basic federal tax of employees working in Quebec (T1 = T3 - 0.165 * T3). Income Tax Act s. 120(2) and Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act s. 27. Source: T4127 table 8.2, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/F-8/
Federal flat tax on a bonus - income threshold

When the annual taxable income A that includes the non-periodic payment payable now is at or below this amount, the federal tax on a bonus, retroactive pay increase or other non-periodic payment is a flat rate of the payment instead of the difference TB (T4127 option 1, tax calculation formulas for bonuses, step 1 note). Sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html
Federal flat tax on a bonus - rate

Rate withheld from a bonus, retroactive pay increase or other non-periodic payment when the annual taxable income including it is at or below l10n_ca.federal.bonus_flat_threshold, outside Quebec (T4127 option 1, tax calculation formulas for bonuses, step 1 note). Sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html
Federal flat tax on a bonus - rate in Quebec

Same as l10n_ca.federal.bonus_flat_rate for an employment in Quebec (T4127 option 1, tax calculation formulas for bonuses, step 1 note: "deduct 15% tax (10% in Quebec)"). Sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/fr/agence-revenu/services/formulaires-publications/retenues-paie/t4127-formules-calcul-retenues-paie-annees-precedentes/t4127-jul-121e-edition-vigueur-1er-juillet-2025/t4127-jul-formules-calcul-retenues-paie.html

Year's maximum pensionable earnings of the CPP. Canada Pension Plan s. 18. The CRA publishes the next year's value in the fall. Sources: T4127 table 8.3, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html
CPP year's additional maximum pensionable earnings (YAMPE)

Second earnings ceiling of the CPP, upper limit of the second additional contributions (CPP2) and of box 26 of the T4. Canada Pension Plan s. 18.1. Sources: T4127 table 8.6, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html

Annual basic exemption of the CPP, divided by the number of pay periods and truncated to the cent. Canada Pension Plan s. 19-20. Sources: T4127 table 8.3, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html
CPP employee contribution rate (base + first additional)

Employee CPP rate, base and first additional, between the basic exemption and the YMPE; the employer pays the same. Canada Pension Plan s. 8 and Schedule 1. 2027: base rate reduced from 4.95% to 4.75% (first additional rate unchanged at 1%) by the Spring Economic Update 2026 Implementation Act, S.C. 2026, c. 22 (Bill C-30, Royal Assent June 18, 2026); the CRA applies 5.75% from January 1, 2027 (2027 row of its CPP rates page). Sources: T4127 table 8.3, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/department-finance/news/2026/06/legislation-passes-to-implement-measures-from-the-spring-economic-update-2026.html ; https://www.parl.ca/legisinfo/en/bill/45-1/C-30

Base part of the employee CPP rate, giving the federal credit (K2); the rest of the rate is the first additional contribution, deducted from income (F5). Canada Pension Plan s. 8. 2027: 4.75% per the Spring Economic Update 2026 Implementation Act, S.C. 2026, c. 22 (Bill C-30), as T4127 123rd edition announces for January 1, 2027. Sources: T4127 table 8.4, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/department-finance/news/2026/06/legislation-passes-to-implement-measures-from-the-spring-economic-update-2026.html ; https://www.parl.ca/legisinfo/en/bill/45-1/C-30

Employee CPP2 rate between the YMPE and the YAMPE; the employer pays the same. Canada Pension Plan s. 8 and Schedule 2. Sources: T4127 table 8.6, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html

Contributions start with the first pay of the month after the employee reaches this age. Canada Pension Plan s. 12(1). Source: T4127 chapter 6, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html

Contributions stop after the last pay of the month the employee reaches this age. Canada Pension Plan s. 12(1). Source: T4127 chapter 6, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html

Maximum annual insurable earnings; the maximum premium is this amount times the rate. Employment Insurance Act s. 4. Sources: T4127 table 8.7, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/employment-insurance-ei/ei-premium-rates-maximums.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/news/2026/09/canada-employment-insurance-commission-confirms-2027-employment-insurance-premium-rate.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/programs/ei/ei-list/reports/premium/rates2027.html

Employee EI premium rate outside Quebec. Employment Insurance Act s. 66. Sources: T4127 table 8.7, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/employment-insurance-ei/ei-premium-rates-maximums.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/news/2026/09/canada-employment-insurance-commission-confirms-2027-employment-insurance-premium-rate.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/programs/ei/ei-list/reports/premium/rates2027.html

Reduced employee EI premium rate of employees working in Quebec, covered by the Quebec Parental Insurance Plan. Employment Insurance Act s. 69. Sources: T4127 table 8.7, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/employment-insurance-ei/ei-premium-rates-maximums.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/news/2026/09/canada-employment-insurance-commission-confirms-2027-employment-insurance-premium-rate.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/programs/ei/ei-list/reports/premium/rates2027.html

The employer premium is this multiple of the employee premium. A reduced rate granted under the Premium Reduction Program is set on the company instead. Employment Insurance Act s. 68. Source: T4127 table 8.7, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/payroll/t4127-payroll-deductions-formulas/t4127-jan/t4127-jan-payroll-deductions-formulas-computer-programs.html ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/E-5.6/
Remittance due day (regular and quarterly remitters)

Day of the month after the period (month or quarter) by which the CRA must receive the source deductions of a regular or quarterly remitter. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1). Sources: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._945/
Accelerated remitter threshold 1 - last day of the first period

Threshold 1 accelerated remitters remit separately the remuneration paid up to this day and after it. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1.1). Source: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html
Accelerated remitter threshold 1 - due day of the first period

Day of the same month by which the deductions of the first period are due. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1.1). Source: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html
Accelerated remitter threshold 1 - due day of the second period

Day of the following month by which the deductions of the second period are due. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1.1). Source: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html
Accelerated remitter threshold 2 - period end days

Days ending the remittance periods of threshold 2 accelerated remitters; the last period ends with the month. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1.1)(b). Source: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html
Accelerated remitter threshold 2 - working days to remit

Number of working days after the end of a period by which the deductions are due. Income Tax Regulations s. 108(1.1)(b): the third day, not counting Saturdays and holidays. Source: T4001, https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html

The T4 slips and summary are due on the last day of this month of the following year. Income Tax Regulations s. 205(1); T4001, Filing information returns: "on or before the last day of February of the following calendar year". Sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/t4001/employers-guide-payroll-deductions-remittances.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/completing-filing-information-returns/t4-information-employers/t4-summary.html ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._945/
